task.description: Fix summarize_results(results), an internal automated test report helper. The MAIN BUG is the pass_rate formula: SKIPPED TESTS MUST BE EXCLUDED FROM THE DENOMINATOR. Counting skipped is still required; only the pass_rate denominator excludes skipped. Input is a list of dictionaries with status passed, failed or skipped. Return a new dict with exactly passed, failed, skipped, pass_rate. Unknown or missing status must raise ValueError. Do not mutate input. No imports. Keep function signature unchanged.
